name: Anastasio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Anastasius II on November 24, 496. He died on November 19, 498.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope John I on August 13, 523. He died a martyr in Ravenna on May 18, 526. His feast in the Roman Martyrology is on May 27.

name: Simmaco
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Symmachus on November 22, 498. He died on July 19, 514. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on July 19.

name: Ormisda
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Hormisdas on July 20, 514. He died on August 6, 523. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrolgy, his feast is celebrated on August 6.

name: Felice
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Felix IV (III) on July 12, 526. He died on September 20 or 22, 530.

name: Bonifacio
in_pectore_note: Named his successor by Pope Felix IV (III), Boniface II became pope on September 22, 530. He died on October 17, 532.

name: Dioscorus
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Dioscorus by the Roman clergy after the death of Pope Felix IV (III), who had named Boniface as his successor. He died 22 days after the election on October 14, 530.

name: Vigilio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Viglius on March 29, 537. He died on June 7, 555. According to the Annuario Pontificio per l'anno 2007, p. 10*, note 14, he was imposed by Belisarius on March 29, 537 and became legitimate pope when Pope Silverius resigned and he was recognized by the Roman clergy, "che sanò così i vizi dell'elezione."

name: Agapito
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Agapetus I on May 13, 535. He died on April 22, 536. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on April 22.

name: Mercurio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope John II on December 31, 532 or January 2, 533. He died on May 8, 535. Annuario Pontificio per l'anno 2001 (Città del Vaticano : Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 2010), p. 9*, indicates that he is the first pope to have changed his name (from Mercury, a Pagan deity) when elected to the papacy.

name: Pelagio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Pelagius I on April 16, 556. He died on March 4, 561.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope John III on July 17, 561. He died on July 13, 574.

name: Deusdedit
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Deusdedit or Adeodato I on October 19, 615. Died on November 8, 618. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on November 8 together with that of Pope Nicholas I the Great.

name: Sabiniano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sabinianus in March 604, he was consecrated on September 13, 604. He died on February 22, 606.

name: Bonifacio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Boniface III on February 19, 607. He died on November 10, 607.

name: Bonifacio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Boniface IV on August 25, 608. He died on May 8, 615. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on May 25; and on June 1, pro clero Romano.

name: Bonifacio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Boniface V on December 23, 619. He died on October 23, 625.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John IV in August 640. He was consecrated on December 24, 640. He died on October 12, 642.

name: Severino
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Severinus in October 638. Consecrated on May 28, 640. Died on August 2, 640.

name: Theodorus
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Theodore I on October 12, 642; consecrated on November 24, 642. He died on May 14, 649.

name: Martino
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Martin I on July 5, 649. Exiled to Crimea by Emperor Constans II on June 17, 653, he resigned in favor of Eugenius, presbyter cardinalis of an unknown title, whom the clergy of Rome had given him as successor. He died on September 16, 655. Inscribed as a martyr in the Roman Martyrolgy, his feast is celebrated on November 12.

name: Eugenio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Vitalian on July 30, 657. He died on January 1, 672. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on January 27.

name: Vitaliano
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Vitalian on July 30, 657. He died on January 1, 672. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on January 27.

name: Dono
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Agatho on June 27, 678. He died January 10, 681. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on January 10.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Leo II in January 681, he was consecrated on August 17, 682. He died on July 3, 683. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast was celebrated for a long time on June 28 until Pope Benedict XV in 1921 transferred it to July 3.

name: Teodoro
in_pectore_note: Elected antipope in 687. He was never consecrated and made his submission to Pope Sergius I. He died ca. 716 (?).

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope John V on July 23, 685. He died on August 2, 686.

name: Benedetto
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Benedict II on June 26, 684. He died on May 8, 685. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on May 8.

name: Conone
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Conon on October 23, 686. He died on September 21, 687.

name: Sergio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Sergius I on December 15, 687. He died on September 7, 701. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on September 8.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope John VI on October 30, 701. He died on January 11, 705.

name: Sisinnius
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Sisinnius on January 15, 708. Died on February 4, 708.

name: Constantinus
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Constantine on March 25, 708. Died on April 9, 715.

name: Gregorio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Gregory II on May 19, 715. Died on February 11, 731. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on February 11.

name: Gregorio
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Gregory III on March 18, 731. Died on Novembr 28, 741. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on December 10 or November 28 pro clero Romano.

name: Zaccaria
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Zacharias on December 3, 741. Died on March 15, 752. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on March 22.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen II on March 27, 752. Died four days after without having received the episcopal consecration. The canon law in force at the time marked the beginning of the pontificate the day the elected was consecrated. For this reason, the Liber Pontificalis, as well as other papal catalogs, do not mention him among the Roman Pontiffs.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Stephen II (III) on March 26, 752. Died on April 26, 757.

name: Paolo
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Paul I on April 29, 757. Died on June 28, 767. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast is celebrated on June 28.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Stephen III (IV) on August 1, 768. Died on January 24, 772.

name: Adriano
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Adrian I on February 1, 772. Died on December 25, 795.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Consecrated Pope Leo III on December 26, 795. Died on June 12, 816. He was included in the catalogue of saints in 1673 by Pope Clement X because of the presumed miracle of the restoration of his eyes and tongue, even though the sources say that it was only an attempt to remove them. His feast, celebrated on February 11 and on May 14 pro clero Romano, has been suppressed..

name: Pasquale
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Paschal I on January 25, 817. Died on February 11, 824. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast, on February 11 or May 14, was suppressed from the liturgical calendar in 1963.

name: Gregorio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Gregory IV in September 827. Died on January 25, 844.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stefano IV (V) on June 22, 816. Died January 24, 817.

name: Eugenio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Eugenius II between February and May 824. Died in August 827.

name: Valentino
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Valentine in August 827. Died in September 827.

name: Sisinnio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sergius II on January 25, 844. Died on January 27, 847.

name: Sergio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sergius II on January 25, 844. Died on January 27, 847.

name: Adriano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Adrian II on December 14, 867. Died on December 14, 872.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Leo IV in January 847. Died July 17, 855. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology, his feast was celebrated on July 17 and is now suppressed.

name: Anastasio
in_pectore_note: Deposed and excommunicated in 864 because of simony.

name: Rodoaldo
in_pectore_note: Deposed and excommunicated in 864 because of simony.

name: Benedetto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict III in July 855. He died on April 17, 858.

name: Niccolò
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Nicholas I on April 24, 858. Died on November 13, 867. Inscribed in the Roman Martyrology by Pope Urban VIII, his feast is on November (September?) 13.

name: Formoso
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Formosus on October 6, 891. Died on April 4, 896. His body was exhumed and he was tried and excommunicated by Pope Stephen V (VI) in January 897, nine months after his death. Buried in a common grave and later thrown in the river Tiber. A hermit retrieved his body and reburied him. He was rehabilitated by Pope John IX in the Roman Synod of April 898.

name: Gauderico
in_pectore_note: Resigned cardinalate in 879 and returned to the monastery of Montecassino.

name: Romano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Romanus in July or August 897. He died in November 897.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John VIII on December 14, 872. He was assassinated on December 16, 882.

name: Marino
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Marinus I in December 882. He died on May 15, 884.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen V (VI) toward the end of September 885. He died at the end of September 891.

name: Adriano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Adrian III on May 17, 884. He died in mid-September 885. His cultus was confirmed on June 2, 1891. His feast, according to the Roman Martyrology, is celebrated on July 8.

name: Sergio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sergius III on January 29, 904. He died on April 14, 911.

name: Bonifacio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Boniface VI on April 11, 896. He died on April 26, 896.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen VI (VII) in May or June 896. He died in July or August 897.

name: Teodoro
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Theodore II in December 897. He died in December 897 or January 898.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John IX in December 897 or January 898. He died between January and May 900.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Leo V in July 903. He died in September 903.

name: Cristoforo
in_pectore_note: He deposed Pope Leone V and installed himself in his place in September 903, taking the name Christopher. He is listed by the sources as both pope and antipope. The official list of popes in Annuario Pontificio per l'anno 2009 (Cittá del Vaticano : Libreria Editrice Vaticana), p. 12*, has him as antipope. He was deposed and imprisoned by Pope Sergius III in January 904. Some authors say that he spent the rest of his life in a monastery and others say that he was murdered in prison. He did not create any pseudocardinals.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Anastasius III in June or September 911. Died in June, August or October 913.

name: Anastasio
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Anastasius III in June or September 911. Died in June, August or October 913.

name: Landone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Landone in July or November 913. Died in March or April 914.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Leo VI in May or June 928. Died in December 928 or January 929.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen VIII (IX) on July 14, 939. Died in late October 942.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XI in March 931. Died in January 936.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen VIII (IX) on July 14, 939. Died in late October 942.

name: Stefano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen VIII (IX) on July 14, 939. Died in late October 942.

name: Marino
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Agapitus II on May 10, 946. Died in December 955.

name: Agapito
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Agapitus II on May 10, 946. Died in December 955.

name: Ottaviano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XII on December 16, 955. Deposed by a Roman synod, convoked and presided by Emperor Otto I, and thus illegitimate, on December 4, 963. Restored by the Romans in February 964. Died on May 14, 964.

name: Benedetto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict V in May 964. He was deposed on June 23, 964. Died on July 4, 966, in exile in Hamburg.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XIII on October 1, 965. Died on September 6, 972.

name: Benedetto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict VI in December 972. Imprisoned in the Castello Sant'Angelo, Rome, he was strangled in July 974, by order of Cardinal Francone, who took his place under the name Boniface VII.

name: Domno
in_pectore_note: "Essai de liste générale des cardinaux. Les cardinaux du XIè siècle". Annuaire Pontifical Catholique 1926 (Paris : Maison de la Bonne Presee, 1927), p. 159, indicates that he was elected pope Donus on December 20, 973, but Annuario Pontificio per l'anno 2009 (Cittá del Vaticano : Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 2009), p. 13*, n. 21, indicates that in 972 a pope that did not exist, Donus, II, used to be listed in the series of Roman pontiffs.

name: Benedetto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict VII in October 974. Died on July 10, 983.

name: Francone
in_pectore_note: Imprisoned and had Pope Benedict VI strangled in 974; took his place in June or July 973 under the name of Boniface VII; and was deposed in August. When Pope John XIV died on August 20, 984, Antipope Boniface VII illegitimately took over the papacy again. He died on July 20, 985.

name: Pietro Canepanova
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XIV in November or December 983. Seized, assaulted, deposed and imprisoned in Castello Sant'Angelo, Rome, by order of Antipope Boniface VII. Died of starvation, or poisoned, on August 20, 984.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XV in August 985. Died without having been consecrated. According to "Essai de liste générale des cardinaux. Les cardinaux du XIè siècle". Annuaire Pontifical Catholique 1926 (Paris : Maison de la Bonne Presee, 1927), p. 159, some consider him antipope and others doubtful. He is not listed in the official series of Roman pontiffs in Annuario Pontificio per l'anno 20092009 (Cittá del Vaticano : Libreria Editrice Vaticana, 2009), p. 13*.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XV (or XVI) in August 985. Died in March 996.

name: Brun von Kärnten
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Gregory V on May 3, 996. Died on February 4, 999.

name: Giovanni Filagato
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope John XVI in February or March 997. Died on August 26, 1001.

name: Siccone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XVII on May 16, 1003. Died on November 6, 1003.

name: Suidger von Morsleben und Hornburg
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Clement II December 24, 1046. Died October 9, 1047.

name: Gerbert
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sylvester II on February 28, 999. Died on May 12, 1003.

name: Fasano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XVIII on December 6, 1003. Died in June/July 1009.

name: Teofilatto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict VIII on May 18, 1012. Died on April 9, 1024.

name: Pietro
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sergius IV on July 31, 1009. Died on May 12, 1012. He is inscribed in the Benedictine Menology, a listing of saints, with brief biographies, arranged in calendar order.

name: Giovanni Graziano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Gregory VI on May 1, 1045; he was the archpresbyter of S. Giovanni a Porta Latina, and godfather or confessor of Pope Benedict IX, who resigned the pontificate in his favor for a large sum of money. Deposed in the Synod of Sutri (1046), he was sent by Emperor Heinrich III to Cologne, where he prepared his testament and died around 1047/1048.

name: Bosone
in_pectore_note: According to Annuaire Pontifical Catholique, 1927, p. 131, n. 1, the see of Tivoli was declared a suburbicarian diocese in 1049 but, without a doubt, many of its occupants had already been personally created cardinals.

name: Romano
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope John XIX on April 19, 1024. Died on October 20, 1032.

name: Teofilatto
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Benedict IX in August or September 1032. He is the only pontiff who has occupied the see of Peter three times: August or September 1032 to September 1044, when he was expelled from Rome and replaced by Pope Sylvester III, whom he excommunicated in February 1045; March 10, 1045 to May 1, 1045, when he retired to his estate and was deposed by the Roman synod of December 23-24, 1046; and October 1047 to July 1048, when he was expelled from Rome for the last time. He died in 1054, in the abbey of Grotta-Ferrata, where he is buried. He created cardinals only in his first pontificate.

name: Giovanni
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Sylvester III on January 13 (or 20), 1045. Expelled from Rome on March 10 of that same year, returned to his see of Sabina. Deposed as pope by the Synod of Sutri on December 20, 1046, was sentenced to be confined in a monastery (the abbey of Grotta-Ferrata) and be deprived of orders. The sentence must have been suspended because he continued to head his diocese until at least 1062. He died before October 1063. There was debate concerning his legitimacy and if he should be considered an antipope but in the revision of the official list of popes effected in 1947, he was declared to be legitimate.

name: Leone
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III in 1180. Deposed as a cardinal by Pope Gregory VII. Died without reconciling with the legitimate pope.

name: Hugo Candidus
in_pectore_note: Accused of simony in the Roman synod of March 1073. Excommunicated by Pope Gregory VII in 1075; and in the Lateran synod of March 3, 1078. Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III in 1084. Never reconciled with the legitimate pope.

name: Frédéric de Lorraine
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Stephen IX (X) on August 2, 1057. Died on March 29, 1058. Louis-Doni d'Attichy, Flores historiae sacri Collegii S. R. E. Cardinalium, calls him a blessed and the Benedictine Martyrology celebrates his feast on March 29.

name: Giovanni Mincius
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Benedict X on April 5, 1058. Deposed by the Synod of Sutri in January 1059. Died ca. 1073/1074.

name: Pietro Damiano
in_pectore_note: Resigned the pastoral government of the suburbicarian see to return to his monastery ca. 1066. Canonized by equipollence (no formal canonization ever took place); his feast is celebrated on February 23. Declared "Doctor of the Church" by Pope Leo XII on October 1, 1828.

name: Bruno
in_pectore_note: Resigned before 1088. Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III in 1092. Died without having made his submission to the legitimate pope.

name: Ugobaldo degli Obizi
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III. Died without having made his submission to the legitimate pope.

name: Ildebrando
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Gregory VII on April 22, 1073. Died May 25, 1085. Pope Gregory XIII placed his name in the Roman Martrology as a blessed in 1584. Pope Paul V auhtorized his cult in 1606; he was declared a saint by Pope Benedict XIII in 1728. His feast is celebrated on May 25.

name: Oderisio
in_pectore_note: Louis-Doni d'Attichy, Flores historiae sacri Collegii S. R. E. Cardinalium, says that he is considered a blessed by the Benedictine Martyrology, which celebrates his feast on December 2.

name: Teodino Sanseverino
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III. Died after repenting and being absolved.

name: Pietro
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III. It is not known when he made his submission to the legitimate pope.

name: Hugues
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III after 1085. Condemned by Pope Victor III in the council of Benevento in August 1087. Made his submission to Pope Urban II.

name: Gerhard
in_pectore_note: According to "Essai de liste générale des cardinaux. Les cardinaux du XIè siècle". Annuaire Pontifical Catholique 1927, p. 141, Louis-Doni d'Attichy, Flores historiae sacri Collegii S. R. E. Cardinalium, declares him a blessed or saint as a result of a popular canonization, but he is not listed in the Roman Martyrology or in the list of those whom the College of Cardinals may celebrate their feast.

name: Pietro Igneo Aldobrandini
in_pectore_note: The Roman Martyrology celebrates his feast on February 8. The Ordo Romanus included his office and mass on March 4, 1673; and the archdiocese of Florence on May 16, 1676.

name: Nicola
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III.

name: Nicola
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III.

name: Eudes de Lagery
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Urban II on March 12, 1088. Died on July 29, 1099. His ancient cultus as a blessed was confirmed by Pope Leo XIII on July 14, 1881. His feast in Rome is celebrated on July 30.

name: Raniero
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Paschal II on August 13, 1099. Died on January 21, 1118. The Benedictine Menology gives him the title of blessed and celebrates his feast on January 18.

name: Richard de Milhau
in_pectore_note: Joined the obedience of Antipope Clement III ca. 1083 and was deposed by Pope Gregory VII. Repented and was reinstated by the same pope. Relapsed and was excommunicated by Pope Victor III in the Council of Benevento in August 1087. Repented and was pardoned and reinstated by Pope Urban II on February 20, 1089.

name: Maginulfo
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Sylvester IV on September 18, 1105. Abdicated on April 12, 1111. Spent the rest of his life under the protection of Count Werner of Ancona, his patron. Died ca. 1111/1112.

name: Teodorico
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Theodoric in September 1100. He was deposed in January 1101. Died in 1102.

name: Berardo
in_pectore_note: In Marsi, he was venerated both in life and after his death because of the miracles that he performed. Pope Pius VII confirmed his veneration as a blessed on May 10, 1802. He is the patron saint of the diocese of Marsi, where his body is kept.

name: Pietro Pierleoni
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Anacletus II on February 14, 1130. Excommunicated by Pope Innocent II in the Council of Reims on October 18, 1131. Died on January 25, 1138. Buried in the patriarchal Lateran basilica, Rome.

name: Pierre de Fontaines
in_pectore_note: His name is inscribed in a Benedictine martyrology and his feast is on December 29.

name: Étienne de Bar
in_pectore_note: His name is inscribed in a Benedictine martyrology and his feast is on December 29.

name: Teobaldo Boccapecora
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Celestine II on December 15 or 16, 1124. Resigned the following day in favor of Honorius II to avoid a schism. The date of his death is uncertain. Since he was not consecrated or enthroned, his name does not appear in the list of popes.

name: Gerardo Caccianemici dell'Orso
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Lucius II on March 9, 1144. Died on February 15, 1145.

name: Gregorio Conti
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Victor IV mid-March 1138. Resigned on March 29 thanks to the intervention of St. Bernard de Clairvaux. Made his submission to Innocent II, who reinstated him to his cardinalitial dignity on May 29, 1138 together with the other cardinals who had followed him. Died ca. 1140.

name: Mathieu
in_pectore_note: Inscribed as a blessed in the Benedictine and Gallican martyrologies.

name: Corrado di Suburra
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Anastasius IV on July 8, 1153. Died on December 3, 1154.

name: Guido di Castello
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Celestine II on September 26, 1143. Died on March 8, 1144.

name: Badouin
in_pectore_note: Inscribed as a blessed in the Cistercian Martyrology.

name: Martino
in_pectore_note: Inscribed as a blessed in the Cistercian and Gallican martyrologies.

name: Ottaviano de' Monticelli
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Victor IV on September 7, 1159. Excommunicated by Pope Alexander III in 1162 and 1163. Died on April 20, 1164. He never reconciled with the legitimate pope.

name: Hugh de Saint-Victor
in_pectore_note: Ludovicus Donius D'Attichy, Flores Historiæ Sacri Collegii S. R. E. Cardinalivm, In Qva Res Ab Ipsis Septem Saecvlorvm decursu, piè, aut sanctè gestae, ordine chronologico distinctæ, atque digestæ describuntur. Dedvcta Illarvm Serie Perpetva Per Pontifices Et Creationes, à temporibus S. Leonis Papæ IX. Sive Ab Anno Christi M.XLIX ... Vsqve Ad Postrema Nostra Tempora ... (Lutetiæ Parisiorum : Cramoisy, 1660), says that he is a blessed .

name: Étienne
in_pectore_note: Inscribed as a blessed in the Cistercian Martyrology and in the Gallican Martyrology.

name: Ubaldo Allucingoli
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Lucius III on September 1, 1181. Died on November 25, 1185.

name: Giacinto Bobone
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Celestine III on March 30, 1191. Died on January 8, 1198.

name: Guarino Foscari
in_pectore_note: Canonized by Pope Alexander III and inscribed in the Roman Martyrology. His feast is on February 6.

name: Nicholas Breakspear
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Adrian IV on December 4, 1154. Died on September 1, 1159. First, and so far, the only English pope.

name: Rolando Bandinelli
in_pectore_note: Elected Pope Alexander III on September 7, 1159. Died on August 30, 1181.

name: Guido di Crema
in_pectore_note: Elected Antipope Paschal III on April 23, 1164. Died of cancer and unrepentant.

name: Bernard
in_pectore_note: He is inscribed as a blessed in the Martyrologe Gallican of Andrè Sauffay. His feast is on May 1.

name: Alberto di Morra
